message: The dress from ORD-1031 doesn't fit me, please refund it.

evidence.sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, delivery_date, product_name, category, unit_price, quantity, order_total, payment_method, status, final_sale FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.orders WHERE customer_id = 'C005' AND order_id = 'ORD-1031'
SELECT refund_id, customer_id, order_id, request_date, amount, reason, decision FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_history WHERE customer_id = 'C005'
SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_policy WHERE category = 'Clothing' OR category = 'ALL'

rows.rule_text: Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: Changed-mind request for a clothing item delivered 19 days ago, within R1's 30-day window; order total $59.90 is under the $200.00 auto-approve limit, not final sale, and not already refunded (E1). However, the customer has exactly 3 approved refunds in the last 90 days (E2), so R8 mandates human review to check for abuse.

critique.reason: Customer has 3 or more approved refunds in the last 90 days.

hard_guard.reason: Customer has 3 or more approved refunds in the last 90 days.

customer_reply: Hi there, thanks for contacting us about your Linen Summer Dress from order ORD-1031. We’ve confirmed the dress was delivered on October 6, 2026, and your request falls within our 30‑day window for changed‑mind returns. Because you’ve had several recent refund requests, our support team will personally review this case and follow up with you soon with a final decision.
limitations: Item condition (unused/unworn) could not be verified from available evidence.
Final refund approval requires manual review by a support lead.
